title: Extend an event emitter without breaking it
task:
`src/emitter.js` has a minimal `Emitter` with `on` and `emit`. Extend it. Existing behavior of `on` and `emit` must keep working.

Add:

- `off(event, listener)`: remove one registration of `listener` (the earliest one) for `event`. Removing a listener that is not registered does nothing. Returns `this`.
- `once(event, listener)`: register a listener that runs at most once and is then removed. `off(event, listener)` with the ORIGINAL function must also remove a pending `once` listener. Returns `this`.
- `listenerCount(event)`: number of listeners currently registered for `event`.

Fix and define `emit(event, ...args)`:

- Returns `true` if the event had listeners when `emit` was called, otherwise `false`.
- Listeners run in registration order with `this` set to the emitter.
- `emit` works on a snapshot taken when it starts: listeners added during an emit are NOT called in that emit, and listeners removed during an emit that have not run yet ARE still called in that emit.
- If a listener throws, the remaining listeners still run, and after all of them have run `emit` rethrows the FIRST error.
- Emitting `'error'` with no listeners throws the first argument if it is an `Error`, otherwise throws a new `Error`.

`on` must keep returning `this`. Run the tests with `npm test`.
